module Faker

    ##

    # @private
    LOWERCASE_LETTERS = LLetters

    class << self

      #
      # @return [String]
      #
      # @example
      #   Faker::Alphanumeric.alpha(number: 10) #=> "zlvubkrwga"
      #
      # @faker.version 1.9.2
      def alpha(number: 32)
        char_count = resolve(number)
        return '' if char_count.to_i < 1

        Array.new(char_count) { sample(LOWERCASE_LETTERS) }.join
      end

part.text:
Fixed. In `Faker::Internet.password` (lib/faker/default/internet.rb:207):

- Added a guaranteed digit character to the password whenever the target length allows it (`password << digit_values[...] if password.length < target_length`), so passwords like `password(min_length: 8, mix_case: true)` always contain at least one number.
- Added digits to the character bag so filler characters can also be digits.
- Documented the behavior in the YARD note.

Verified with 2000+ generated passwords (digits always present), plus `test_faker_internet.rb` (180 tests), determinism, alphanumeric, number, and core test files all pass. `rake test` itself fails with a `SystemStackError` even on the clean tree (pre-existing environment issue), so tests were run per-file as the repo's suite does.
